name: nightly
description: The workspace's maintenance pass: fold session fragments into the log, rebuild the generated files to a fixpoint (registry, related blocks, trigger routes, history indexes), then verify. The check run asks the generators whether anything is out of date and writes nothing.

check.description: Is any generated file out of date? The generators in check mode; writes nothing

rebuild.description: Rebuilds the generated files and lists what it wrote; never commits
